patterns.name: Function
patterns.description: A reusable block of code that performs a specific task.
patterns.best_practice: Use meaningful function names and keep functions focused.

patterns.name: Input Validation
patterns.description: Checks whether input values are valid before processing.
patterns.best_practice: Validate inputs and handle invalid values gracefully.

patterns.name: Exception Handling
patterns.description: Handles runtime errors using try and except.
patterns.best_practice: Catch specific exceptions instead of broad exceptions.

patterns.name: Code Reusability
patterns.best_practice: Extract repeated logic into reusable functions.

patterns.name: Naming Conventions
patterns.best_practice: Use descriptive snake_case names in Python.

patterns.name: Type Hints
patterns.description: Specifies expected input and return types.
patterns.best_practice: Add type hints to improve readability.
